rule_or_requirement: Local candidates must finish the qualified line on at least as many matched cells as the selected control before a faster lap can justify advancement.
observable_information: At inference, four grayscale frames and pixel-only road, speed, and obstacle diagnostics; evaluator records finish, action, speed, road contact, and runtime.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Preserve frozen opening launch and fixed early pixel bend steering only; no added gas or braking.
expected_success_endpoint: Unchanged launch-plus-steering ZIP has no lower finish count than unchanged launch-only ZIP on held-out cells; on completion tie median lap is shorter.
falsifier: Lower candidate finish count, candidate-only nonfinish, invalid action/resource breach; on tie no median finished-lap improvement.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Unchanged exact ZIPs on held-out tracks 1-3 by seeds 7028-7031, 12 paired cells and 24 episodes, 2000 decisions each.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local Linux CPU 2 CPUs, 2 GiB, 1800 seconds; confirmation 7032-7035 remains closed unless held-out passes.
